title: County Critters on the Job: Wolf Connection
description: Welcome to County Critters – a show that highlights the extraordinary working animals that are a crucial part of the Los Angeles County workforce. Meet the pack of Wolf Connection one of many ‘County Critters’ who work to help make lives better throughout L.A. County. Wolf Connection is also a space where military veterans and local youth can find their healthiest self through nature walks, healing circles, and more all while bonding with the wolves.
